statements.t: In September 2026, we approved a plan to close our DMT production facility in Marlborough, Massachusetts, and transition production of the DMT products to more cost-effective third-party manufacturers in China.
We expect to complete the closure in the fourth quarter of 2026.
We expect the closure of the DMT production facility to result in annual cost savings of more than $1.0 million beginning in 2027.
